TECHNOLOGY
"Infrastructure to meet all of your security, availability and performance needs.."
INFRASTRUCTURE

"Performance, Resilience, Secure..."

A well-designed infrastructure is essential if your business systems are to perform optimally at all times. Corporatec specialises in the design, development and installation of IT infrastructures specific to the hedge fund industry.

​

We will design and develop a resilient infrastructure to meet all of your security, availability, performance and business continuity needs.

VENDOR NEUTRAL

"Free from vendor limitations..."

Corporatec are vendor-independent. This means we are able to guide you through the complexities of available technology and provide you with impartial advice based on your needs and budget.

​

When it comes to selecting equipment, our focus is on you and not a supplier.

GLOBAL WORKFORCE

"Control from everywhere..."

The ability to move people across borders and time zones has never been more important.

​

We enable remote access to your business-critical information and applications, allowing you to control your investment operations from any location in the world.

SYSTEMS MONITORING

"Real time monitoring and alerting..."

Our real-time monitoring and alerting platform is built using industry standard technology and in house software.  Digging deeper into the health of your systems, we provide insight and awareness into the state of your infrastructure.

​

Our robust, fully-managed service runs independently of your infrastructure and dependencies, performing regular checks and receiving instant alerts for warnings and alarms.
